{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with NaN revenue (6 rows)
sales_clean = sales.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = sales_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

total_revenue_by_channel"}
